Usage: yantra model add [options] <id>

Options:
  --provider <provider>
  --base-url <url>
  --api-key-ref <reference>
  --input <kinds>            comma-separated: text,image (default: "text")
  --force                    replace an existing provider/id pair (default:
                             false)
  --json                     emit JSON (default: false)
  -h, --help                 display help for command
